features.name: Draconic Resilience

rules.text:
Level 3: Draconic Resilience
The magic in your body manifests physical traits
of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you
gain another Sorcerer level.
Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like
scales. While you aren’t wearing armor, your base
Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

rules.text:
Level 3: Draconic Spells
When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the
Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have
the listed spells prepared. Draconic Spells
Sorcerer

3 Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command,
Dragon’s Breath
5 Fear, Fly
7 Arcane Eye, Charm Monster
9 Legend Lore, Summon Dragon

preparation.source: SRD 5.2.1, Sorcerer Subclass: Draconic Sorcery, PDF pp.69-70
preparation.scope: Sorcerer levels 3-5 only. Level 6+ features (Elemental Affinity, Dragon Wings, Dragon Companion) and Draconic Spells rows 7 and 9 are deliberately omitted.
preparation.loading: This file lives outside data/core and data/mods and is never read by DataLoader. It is not acceptance, not an enabled placeholder, and must not be copied into data/core/subclasses until every entry in missing_consumers has an accepted generic owner.

missing_consumers.clause: Draconic Resilience: Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level
missing_consumers.gap: No feature-owned, class-level-scaled permanent max-HP grant. PermanentProgressionRules max_hp_delta is fixed-amount, opt-in permanent_progression only and rejects subclasses; MaxHpSourceRules (S-130) is a reversible fixed-amount effect host. Needs a generic once-only, saved, per-class-level grant (V-026).

missing_consumers.clause: Draconic Resilience: while you aren't wearing armor, base AC = 10 + DEX + CHA (Shield allowed, but its benefit needs Shield training, SRD p.92)
missing_consumers.gap: Existing unarmored_defense host fits the formula, but (a) Character._equipment_base_ac adds a Shield's ac_bonus without checking Shield training; (b) get_feature_effect takes the first unarmored_defense effect rather than a chosen/best base (SRD p.7 Only One Base AC); (c) Character.level_up does not call _recalculate_ac, so a level-3 grant leaves cached base_ac stale until equipment changes.
